A Night of Queer Fire: Stemin’s Tales of a Gay Romance Release Concert at Cinetol

May 19, 2025·1 min read·234 views
WINGS Magazine
0shares

Rubx Paris: A Latex Lover’s Dream Returns This June

Read More
Home
News

Darlings, mark your calendars and polish your harnesses—June 14 is going to be steamy in all the right ways. The luscious and unapologetically queer artist Stemin is dropping his brand-new album, Tales of a Gay Romance, and celebrating the release with a live concert at Cinetol, Amsterdam.

Now, this isn’t your run-of-the-mill album launch. Tales of a Gay Romance is an ode to queer love, lust, heartbreak, and euphoria. Think The Weeknd, but make it gloriously, proudly gay—with glitter in all the right places. Stemin fuses smooth, sultry pop production with deeply intimate storytelling that feels like a private diary cracked open under a disco ball.

Born into a devout religious family in Southern Italy, Stemin’s story is one of repression flipped on its head. This album pulses with the energy of someone who’s shaken off the chains and decided to live out loud. Each track seduces, aches, and celebrates in equal measure—whether you’re in the throes of new love or licking the wounds of desire.

And the concert? Expect more than just vocals. We’re talking dancers, visuals, and a hedonistic, heart-filled atmosphere dripping with queer joy. Think less “sit politely” and more “dance, cry, and kiss your friends.” Basically, the queer concert experience we all deserve.

DETAILS
June 14
Cinetol, Amsterdam
Stemin – Tales of a Gay Romance album release show
Expect glitter, sweat, and radical self-love

Tickets & more info: cinetol.nl/events/stemin

This is more than a performance. It’s a celebration of every queer soul who’s dared to love loudly. So grab your tickets, bring your babes, and get ready to feel everything.

See you in the glitter.
